title: FB-031 require explicit Tauri PG state evidence paths
summary: Fix FR-037 by removing machine-specific default runtime state paths from Tauri PG validation scripts.
reason: Worker findings showed PG scripts defaulted validation evidence lookups to E:\Videos\Scratch\State, coupling evidence to one operator machine unless callers overrode the paths.
behavior_before: PG scripts silently read ActiveJobs or Sample Validation evidence from a hardcoded machine-specific runtime state path.
behavior_after: PG scripts require explicit, fully qualified evidence paths and reject the legacy machine-specific state root.
manual_validation: Bundled PowerShell parser check passed for Test-TauriShell-PG1ActiveClose.ps1, Test-TauriShell-PG2WebViewLaunch.ps1, and Test-TauriShell-PG2SampleValidationAppend.ps1.

Bundled Python with PYTHONPATH=src: python -m unittest tests.python.desktop.test_tauri_shell_scaffold.TauriShellScaffoldTests.test_tauri_pg_harnesses_require_explicit_runtime_evidence_paths -q passed.
Direct temp-source invocations of all three PG scripts with explicit E:\Videos\Scratch\State evidence paths failed with the expected legacy-root rejection.
Direct temp-source invocations of all three PG scripts without evidence path parameters failed fast with the expected required-parameter errors.
Full tests.python.desktop.test_tauri_shell_scaffold -q was attempted and failed on unrelated stale static expectations outside FB-031.
rollback_plan: Restore the previous default PG evidence paths, then rerun the Tauri scaffold tests.
notes: Validation harness behavior only; no production Tauri lifecycle or backend runtime behavior changes.
